lines.text: Every franchised McDonald's sends headquarters a cut of every sale.
lines.say: Every franchised McDonald's sends headquarters a cut of every sale.

lines.text: US royalty: 4% of sales, 5% for new restaurants since 2024.
lines.say: US royalty: four percent, five for new restaurants since twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: That buys the brand, the system and training. Ads add 4% or more.
lines.say: That buys the brand, the system and training. Ads add four percent or more.

lines.text: The bigger check is rent, also tied to sales, because McDonald's usually controls the real estate.
lines.say: The bigger check is rent, also tied to sales, because McDonald's usually controls the property.

lines.text: In 2025: $10.4 billion in rent, $6.0 billion in royalties.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five: ten point four billion in rent, six billion in royalties.
All franchise revenue: sixteen and a half billion dollars in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Hypothetically, a new US store selling $3 million a year pays 5% + 4% = 9%: $270,000, before rent.
lines.say: Hypothetically, a new US store selling three million dollars a year pays nine percent: two hundred seventy thousand, before rent.

lines.text: The FTC requires a disclosure document listing the fees at least 14 days before you sign or pay.
lines.say: The F T C requires a disclosure document listing the fees at least fourteen days before you sign or pay.

lines.text: The brand isn't selling burgers here. It rents out a system and the land under it.

post.title: Why McDonald's owners hand HQ a cut of every sale
post.ig:
Every franchised McDonald's sends headquarters a cut of every sale.
US royalty: 4% of gross sales, 5% for new restaurants since 2024, plus 4%+ for advertising.
The bigger check is rent: $10.4B in 2025 vs $6.0B in royalties.
Franchise revenue: $16.5B in 2025; about 95% of restaurants are franchised.
Hypothetical new US store: $3M in sales x (5% + 4%) = $270,000 a year, before rent.
Sources: McDonald's 2025 Form 10-K, McDonald's franchise disclosure document, FTC Franchise Rule.
News and education, not financial advice.

In 2025 McDonald's took in $10.4B in rent and $6.0B in royalties (2025 Form 10-K). The FTC Franchise Rule requires a disclosure document at least 14 days before signing.
